description: List one seller's monitored x402 endpoints with each one's grade, score, verdict, 7-day uptime, median response time, whether a real test payment was delivered, and how many checks it's based on, plus the seller's counts per verdict and its refund record (how many of our failed paid calls it refunded in the last 30 days). Use it after list_sellers to pick the best endpoint from a provider, or to see which of a seller's endpoints to avoid. For the full reasons behind one endpoint's grade use check_endpoint. Read-only and free; 50 endpoints per page at most.

host.description: The seller's domain, e.g. api.example.com (a full URL works too)

offset.description: Skip this many endpoints, for paging (default 0)

query.description: Part of the endpoint URL to search for, e.g. a path like '/weather'

sort.description: Order: by URL (default), best score first, or worst score first

name: seller_endpoints

counts.description: All of the seller's endpoints per verdict

verdict.description: proceed | caution | avoid | free | insufficient_data | bulk_listing

forTeams.description: Short note about team plans (per-agent keys, spend limits, audit trail)

refunds.description: The seller's refund record from our paid tests (v1.78.0)

failedCharged.description: Our paid tests on this seller that failed after charging

refunded.description: How many of those the seller refunded on-chain

title: One seller's x402 endpoints
